atomic_task_state

  subject_id=service:checkout
  subject_id=service:reporting

affected_service:
  service_id=service:checkout
  service_id=service:reporting

  service_id=service:checkout

  service_id=service:reporting adapter_id=adapter:reporting-json-v3

  service_id=service:reporting old_library_id=library:jsonlib-v2 new_library_id=library:jsonlib-v3 adapter_id=adapter:reporting-json-v3

verified_by:
  service_id=service:checkout test_id=test:checkout-contract
  service_id=service:reporting test_id=test:reporting-contract

verification_gap:
  (none)
completeness:
  affected_service: status=COMPLETE universe=production_service stale=False current=True
  whole_world: NOT_COMPLETE

source_relation_tuple(s): excluded(subject_id=service:partner-gateway, basis=vendor-owned boundary remains on the supported v2 protocol)
compiled_fields.subject: service:partner-gateway
compiled_fields.value: vendor-owned boundary remains on the supported v2 protocol

compiled_fields.derivation_rule: COMPLETE iff current COMPLETE receipt over production_service
NOT_COMPLETE from absence of a whole-world COMPLETE contract

compiled_text:
migration_surface

checkout
  disposition: DIRECT_CHANGE
  scope: IN_SCOPE
  verification: VERIFIED
  verified_by: checkout-contract

reporting
  disposition: PROTECTED
  scope: IN_SCOPE
  protected_by: reporting-json-v3
  compatible_via: jsonlib-v2 -> jsonlib-v3 via reporting-json-v3
  verification: VERIFIED
  verified_by: reporting-contract

partner-gateway
  disposition: EXCLUDED_BOUNDARY
  exclusion_basis: vendor-owned boundary remains on the supported v2 protocol

external-worker
  disposition: UNRESOLVED_SCOPE

scope_receipt
  affected_service: COMPLETE
  whole_world: NOT_COMPLETE

rules.derivation_rule: PROTECTED(x, a) <- protected_by(x, a) AND NOT requires_change(x)
compatible_via field copies the compatible_via tuple for x
EXCLUDED_BOUNDARY(x, basis) <- boundary(x) AND excluded(x, basis) AND NOT requires_change(x) AND NOT protected_by(x, _)
UNRESOLVED_SCOPE(x) <- unresolved_scope(x) AND no higher-priority disposition
scope IN_SCOPE iff in_scope(x); omitted otherwise
VERIFIED <- current verified_by tuple for x
rules.source_relation_tuple(s): verified_by(x, t) AND x not in verification_gap

rules.derivation_rule: COMPLETE iff receipt status is COMPLETE and not stale; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE
Always NOT_COMPLETE: fixture has no whole-world completeness contract
rules.source_relation_tuple(s): absence of any COMPLETE completeness receipt whose universe is whole-world
